senses.gloss:
हु €3 P. (जुहोति, हुत; pass. हूयते; caus.
 हावयति-ते; desid. जुहूषति)
—1 To offer or present (as oblation to fire); make an offering to or in
 honour of a deity (with acc.); sacrifice; यो मन्त्रपूतां तनुमप्यहौषीत्
 R. 13. 45; जटाधरः सन् जुहुधीह पावकम् Ki. 1. 44; हविर्जुहुधि
 पावकम् Bk. 20. 11; Ms. 3. 87; Y. 1. 99.
—2 To perform a sacrifice. —3 To eat.

हू ind.
—1 An interjection of calling.
—2 Of contempt.
—3 Of pride.
—4 Of grief (oh! ah! alas &c.).
